# DreamEx Tech — Autonomous AI Engineering Operating System (v6.0)

> DreamEx Tech (https://dreamex.tech) is a client-sovereign AI Engineering Operating System uniting 5-Agent Live UI Prototyping, Universal Scalability Law (USL) distributed systems architecture, Self-Healing Playwright QA automation, Executable Gherkin/RTM Business Analysis, 10,000-trial Monte Carlo Jira delivery forecasting, and Zero-Trust Security/SBOM governance.

## Flagship Interactive Suites
- [Autonomous AI Prototype & Multi-Agent Studio](https://dreamex.tech/prototype): Orchestrate 5 specialized engineering AI agents, test responsive Desktop/Tablet/Mobile sandboxes with RBAC & chaos failover, model LLM token ROI, and export a 7-file production starter .zip.
- [AI Readiness, Security & Architecture Grader](https://dreamex.tech/grader): Audit any public HTTPS website or GitHub repository across Zero-Trust CSP/HSTS headers, /llms.txt AI discovery, semantic accessibility, and edge latency, with dynamic SVG badges.
- [6-Pillar Sovereign IT Workbench](https://dreamex.tech/tools): Unified deterministic workbench for Software Engineers, QA/UAT, Business Analysts, Project Managers, Jira REST v3 ADF, and DevSecOps.
- [BA Requirement, Gherkin & RTM Studio](https://dreamex.tech/ba-hub): Compile BRD intents into Gherkin BDD scenarios and bi-directional Requirement Traceability Matrices.
- [Jira Agile Board, Backlog & Sprint OS](https://dreamex.tech/jira): Full Jira Scrum/Kanban workspace with WIP guardrails, swimlanes, backlog sprint planning, Epic Gantt timeline, executable JQL, burndown/velocity charts, automation rules, and Atlassian REST v3 ADF / CSV export.
- [PM Monte Carlo & Jira Neural Hub](https://dreamex.tech/pm-jira-hub): Synthesize Jira REST API v3 ADF payloads, visual JQL queries, and 10,000-trial sprint forecasts.
- [Unified Engineering Workspace](https://dreamex.tech/workspace): Search and launch all 25+ role-indexed engineering suites.

## Technical Research & Architecture Studies
- [Merancang Playwright Test Suite yang Stabil](https://dreamex.tech/blog/playwright-test-architecture) (2026-10-10): Pola page object yang proporsional, locator yang tangguh, isolasi data, dan strategi mengurangi flaky test.
- [Tata Kelola Kontrak API, Idempotency & Outbox Pattern](https://dreamex.tech/blog/api-contract-governance-idempotency) (2026-10-09): Mencegah transaksi ganda dan pergeseran skema antar microservice melalui kontrak runtime dan idempotency key.
- [Checklist Keamanan Dasar untuk Pipeline CI/CD](https://dreamex.tech/blog/secure-ci-cd-basics) (2026-10-07): Praktik least privilege, pengelolaan secret, dependency hygiene, dan perlindungan supply chain perangkat lunak.
- [Menghubungkan BRD, Gherkin BDD, dan Otomasi Jira REST v3](https://dreamex.tech/blog/requirements-traceability-jira-adf) (2026-10-06): Menjaga keterlacakan kebutuhan bisnis hingga test case Playwright dan tiket Jira terstruktur tanpa pekerjaan manual berulang.
- [Membangun Evaluasi AI yang Bisa Diulang](https://dreamex.tech/blog/evaluating-ai-features) (2026-10-03): Rancang dataset, rubrik penilaian, regression checks, dan pemantauan agar perubahan AI dapat dinilai secara objektif.
- [Mengganti Tebakan Deadline dengan Simulasi Monte Carlo P85](https://dreamex.tech/blog/monte-carlo-forecasting-delivery) (2026-10-02): Mengukur kepastian rilis sprint secara kuantitatif menggunakan distribusi throughput historis dan metrik EVM.
- [Membangun Fondasi QA Automation yang Andal](https://dreamex.tech/blog/qa-automation-foundations) (2026-10-01): Prinsip memilih test case, menjaga stabilitas suite, dan membuat hasil pengujian dapat dipercaya.
- [TypeScript untuk Proyek yang Mudah Dipelihara](https://dreamex.tech/blog/typescript-for-maintainable-projects) (2026-09-24): Cara memanfaatkan tipe, kontrak, dan batas modul agar perubahan lebih aman.
- [Menerapkan AI dengan Pendekatan Engineering](https://dreamex.tech/blog/practical-ai-engineering) (2026-09-18): Evaluasi kualitas, batasan, observability, dan pengujian untuk fitur berbasis AI.
